title: Admissible C¹ cutoff sequence with widths tending to zero (parent Steps 1–2)
statement: For every real a > 0 there exist functions φ_m: ℝ → ℝ and reals ε_m (m ∈ ℕ) such that ε_m → 0 as m → ∞ and, for every m: 0 < ε_m < a; φ_m is of class C¹; φ_m is nonincreasing; φ_m(t) = 1 for all t ≤ 1; φ_m(t) = 0 for all t ≥ 1 + ε_m; and 0 ≤ φ_m(t) ≤ 1 for all t ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (a : ℝ), 0 < a → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ m, 0 < ε m ∧ ε m < a ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ m) ∧ Antitone (φ m) ∧ (∀ t, t ≤ 1 → φ m t = 1) ∧ (∀ t, 1 + ε m ≤ t → φ m t = 0) ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ φ m t ∧ φ m t ≤ 1)
